verdict.rationale: Zero documents AI-assisted composition and creating drafts, and the founder describes it as an email client that drafts replies, so the core of AI-drafted replies ready for review exists. Nothing shows the drafts are tailored to the user's own voice or tone rather than generic text. Missing for 10: evidence of learning or matching the user's writing voice and tone, documentation of a reply-drafting workflow (draft-to-review-to-send UX), and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
